units.source_text: 果如僧都所言：此间草木与山上并无不同，

en.t: Just as the bishop had said, the plants and trees here were no different from those on the mountain,

units.source_text: 然而布置意匠巧妙，另有一般雅趣。

en.t: yet the arrangement was so cleverly designed that it had a special elegance of its own.
At this hour there was no moon,

units.source_text: 庭中各处池塘上点着篝火，吊灯也点亮了。

en.t: and bonfires were lit beside the ponds throughout the garden, while hanging lamps had also been kindled.

units.source_text: 朝南一室，陈设十分雅洁。

en.t: A south-facing room was furnished with exceptional elegance and purity.

units.source_text: 不知哪里飘来的香气[\[9\]](#part1334.html#m9)沁人心肺，

en.t: A fragrance drifting from somewhere unknown [\[9\]](#part1334.html#m9) sank deep into the heart,

units.source_text: 佛前的名香也到处弥漫，源氏公子的衣香则另有一种佳趣。

en.t: the fine incense before the Buddha spread everywhere, and the scent of Prince Genji's robes had yet another exquisite charm.

units.source_text: 因此住在内室中的妇女都很兴奋。

en.t: Because of this, all the women in the inner rooms were stirred with excitement.

units.source_text: 僧都为公子讲述人世无常之理，以及来世果报之事。

en.t: The bishop explained to the prince the truth of worldly impermanence and the karmic consequences of the life to come.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起自己所犯种种罪过，不胜恐惧。

en.t: Prince Genji recalled the many sins he had committed and was overcome with fear.

units.source_text: 觉得心中充塞了卑鄙无聊之事，

en.t: He felt that his heart was filled with base and foolish things,

units.source_text: 此生将永远为此而忧愁苦恨，

en.t: and that in this life he would forever grieve and suffer because of them,

units.source_text: 何况来世，不知将受何等残酷的果报！

en.t: to say nothing of the next life, where he could not know what cruel retribution he might receive.

units.source_text: 想到这里，他也欲模仿这僧都入山修行了。

en.t: Thinking this, he too wished to follow the bishop's example and enter the mountains to practice religion.

units.source_text: 然而傍晚所见那女孩的面影，历历在心，恋恋不忘。

en.t: Yet the image of the girl he had seen that evening remained vividly in his heart, and he could not forget her.

units.source_text: 便问道：“住在这里的是什么人？

en.t: So he asked, "Who is it that lives here?

units.source_text: 我曾经做一个奇怪的梦，梦中向你探问此事。

en.t: I once had a strange dream, and in that dream I asked you about this very matter.
I never expected it to come true today."
